name: Owner-Operator 1–5 ICP Sub
title: Never86 ICP — Owner-Operator 1–5
description: Owns Owner-Operator 1–5 (1–5). Buyer: Owner / GM (still in the building). Single-owner ops: paper labor cards, weekly schedules, Toast day exports; still photographing paper invoices even when vendors email PDFs. Pains: owner burnout and cash-flow gut feel; labor % without group targets; second unit ~130% ops surface for ~60% revenue capacity; inventory = invoice photos + Hy-Vee runs; weekly phone-photo AP instead of forwarding email invoices; human staple/photograph loop — not a repeatable system. Wedge: Coach email-invoice intake into a repeatable AP system — kill the weekly photo/staple grind; daily leak dollars not enterprise BI.
